notes: Release WebAssembly build with the app's own Debug sample-data hooks compiled in (src/tools/sample-hooks.targets); a plain Release build opens on empty onboarding.
One capture session: the Draft quote's age reads Just now, 1m ago or 8m ago depending on the banner; no banner shows two ages side by side.
The showcase banners show whole screens, so their UI text is under 10 px at 1x, as in the house-style banners.
Softened on purpose: the back sheets in stylized-sheets and the item list in focus-catalog.
At DPR 3 the app dropped the click after a list or tab selection in headless Chromium; cap.js checks each state and clicks again.
